subject: Onboarding: shortlist pruning, context-window tradeoffs, and token spike simulation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@greenline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: shortlist pruning, context-window tradeoffs, and token spike simulation

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the onboarding sync last week. I'm kicking off the implementation handoff thread so we can lock the model shortlist, confirm context-length tradeoffs, and schedule a token-spike simulation to validate throughput and tail latency. Below is a concise summary and the asks we need from Greenline before we run the simulation.

High-level objective:
- Choose 1–2 model candidates to validate in a short spike (48–72h) that exercise your realistic workload (user chats + doc ingestion). We want to measure token throughput, 95/99th latency, and cost-per-1M tokens estimates.

Proposed shortlist (we exported as onboarding-model-shortlist.csv attached):
- rw-13b-int8-optimized (recommended default: lower cost, good for chat-heavy workloads)
- mistral-chat-7b-v2 (fast single-token latency, good for short interactions)
- llama2-70b-q4f16 (higher context fidelity for long docs; higher cost)
- redwood-32k-13b (32k context variant — keep as a candidate if you need long-doc retrieval)

Context and token profile we observed in discovery: (please confirm / correct)
- Typical interactive session: median ~300 tokens per turn, median 3–5 turns per session => ~1k tokens/session.
- Document ingestion use-case: 10–15% of sessions will attach/ingest a long file; average ingested doc ~4k tokens, worst-case up to 18k tokens.
- Concurrency: expected peak concurrent users 40–60 (we used 50 for estimates).
- Monthly DAU estimate you shared: ~2,500 active users (rough).

Rough token math (please sanity-check):
- Daily active sessions (est): 2,500 * 0.6 sessions/day = 1,500 sessions/day -> ~1.5M tokens/day baseline (interactive)
- Add document ingestion tail: assume 10% sessions with +4k tokens = +600k tokens/day
- Peak spike scenario (planned test): 10x burst for 15 minutes at peak concurrency ~500 concurrent tokens/sec -> used to validate autoscaling and fallbacks

Asks from Greenline before we run the spike:
1) Confirm average tokens/session (if different from the ~1k number above).
2) Confirm frequency/distribution of long documents (how often >8k, >16k).
3) Share a representative sample prompt + doc (PII scrubbed) we can use in the simulation (or confirm we can synthesize).
4) Approve spike window options: Thursday 08/12 10:00–12:00 PT or Monday 08/16 10:00–12:00 PT. We prefer one 2-hour canary then a broader 1-day spike if all looks good.

What Redwood will run during the spike:
- Canary load against two model variants (rw-13b-int8-optimized + redwood-32k-13b) for 2 hours.
- Measure 50/95/99 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, mem/KV cache behavior, and token-unit cost.
- Validate automatic fallback to lower-cost variant if latency SLO exceeds thresholds.

Next steps / timeline:
- Liam confirm items 1–4 above by EOD tomorrow -> we’ll lock the canary window.
- Ben will own the spike run (ben.carter@redwood.ai) and coordinate with your ops.
- Monica will own post-spike evaluation and model recommendation.

Attachment: onboarding-model-shortlist.csv (model names, quantization profiles, expected RPS at 95th percentile)
Attachment: greenline_spike_test_plan.pdf (detailed test steps)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0132

Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@greenline.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding: shortlist pruning, context-window tradeoffs, and token spike simulation

Thanks Tessa — quick clarifications from our side: we reviewed the packet and the shortlist looks sensible. A couple of data points to correct your estimates: 

- Our more-accurate median interactive session is closer to ~450 tokens/turn (we have longer prompts) and avg 2.2 turns/session => ~1k tokens/session (so your baseline is close).
- Document ingestion: roughly 12% of sessions include a doc; average ~3.8k tokens, but we do have a long-tail: about ~2% of those go above 12k, and ~0.5% can hit ~18k when users upload full reports.
- Concurrency: weekday peak is 55 concurrent; weekend peak ~18.
- We can provide a sanitized sample set: I'll upload 5 representative prompts + 3 doc samples to the Drive folder you created.

Spike window: Monday 08/16 10:00 PT works better for our ops team (gives us time to vet the sample set).

One ask: for the canary, can we also include a run with caching disabled (to simulate cold-start behavior) so we can see worst-case KV cache impact?

Happy to kick off Monday. Ben / Monica — can you confirm readiness for 08/16?

Best,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Product Integrations
Greenline Analytics

+44 7700 900111
